question: Which of the following choices is related to the phylum Coelenterata?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Aurelia__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is Aurelia, which belongs to the phylum Coelenterata, also known as Cnidaria.
 
• Coelenterata (Cnidaria) includes marine animals that are distinguished by their radial symmetry, a central gastrovascular cavity, and the presence of cnidocytes (stinging cells).
 
• Aurelia, commonly known as the moon jellyfish, is a typical example of this phylum, showcas
